lines.t: What Is Pure?
Giving thanks to God
In My name is pure worship,
Yet the wicked man
Demands honor for himself.
The heart of a child is pure,
Yet the heart of the mature is corrupt...
Says The Lord YahuShua.
The Spirit of Unity
The spirit of unity is in Me, walking in My footsteps, doing unto others as you would have them do unto you; remembering that all you do to others, whether good or bad, you have done also to Me.
Have I not spoken to this already, in the Gospel of My servant, John? For I said to love one another, and to wash each other’s feet, and that you can do nothing apart from Me.
Therefore be one in Me,
Even as I long to be one with you,
Even as The Father and I are One,
That our love may be made perfect in One...
You in Me, I in you,
To the joy of The Father...
Says The Lord YahuShua.
